# Fixture sources

`digital-agency-news.html` and `ndl-news.html` are unmodified copies of public pages, retrieved on 2026-11-13. Both sites publish their content under the Public Data License 1.0 (PDL 1.0), which is compatible with CC BY 4.0 and allows reuse with attribution.

| File | Source | Terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `digital-agency-news.html` | Digital Agency, 新着・更新 (https://www.digital.go.jp/news) | https://www.digital.go.jp/copyright-policy |
| `ndl-news.html` | National Diet Library, おしらせ一覧 (https://www.ndl.go.jp/news) | https://www.ndl.go.jp/sitepolicy |

出典：デジタル庁ウェブサイト「新着・更新」（https://www.digital.go.jp/news）
出典：国立国会図書館ウェブサイト「おしらせ一覧」（https://www.ndl.go.jp/news）

`synthetic.html` is a fictional page written for this project to cover cases real sites don't, such as `javascript:` links and inline scripts.
